name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: US–Iran war: more tankers hit at Hormuz as Trump says war will end 'one way or the other'
state: The war that began with US–Israeli strikes on Iran on 28 Feb continues with a US naval blockade and Iranian attacks on shipping; Iran said two tankers hit mines in Hormuz on 1 Nov. Talks with mediators on a two-day plan to reopen the strait continue, Trump said on 1 Nov the war would end 'very soon, one way or the other', and he has not ruled out strikes after the 3 Nov midterms.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to much of the region; follow its travel advice and airline updates.
rubric_hit: Active interstate war with attacks on shipping = Alert
